newsitem.title: UK: Cook says its current new car sales up 25pct.
newsitem.headline: Cook says its current new car sales up 25pct.

text.p: D.C. Cook Holdings Plc chairman Derek Cook said the group's current new car sales were up 25 percent over a year ago.
Speaking at the company's annual meeting, Cook said he was also "very pleased with the increase in used car sales."
He added that the company expected to open several new sites this year, some with major franchises and some as independent nearly new vehicle sales outlets.
"We continue to look for opportunities to acquire established businesses," he added.
